semiconductor_relevance: High — Shin-Etsu Chemical specializes in advanced equipment and materials for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in innovative laser technologies.
summary: Shin-Etsu Chemical provides cutting-edge laser equipment and materials for semiconductor packaging and processing. Their technologies enable high-speed, non-contact transfer of micro devices and innovative patterning solutions that enhance the performance and efficiency of semiconductor packages.
capabilities: Excimer laser equipment for IC package substrate processing
Ultra high-speed laser mass transfer equipment for micro devices
Ablation materials optimized for laser transfer processes
